skill.name: brevo-automation
skill.description: Automate Brevo email marketing workflows through Rube MCP, including campaigns, templates, senders, and A/B testing setup.
skill.summary: Guide Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through Brevo campaign and template automation with Rube MCP.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: Static command detections are false positives from Markdown backticks around Brevo and Rube tool names, parameters, and examples. The hardcoded Rube MCP endpoint is a real but expected network dependency, and the replyTo line is not reconnaissance. A semantic finding notes that remote MCP authentication expands the Brevo account trust boundary.

remediation.suggestion: Clearly disclose that Rube or Composio processes Brevo operations and require explicit user approval before authentication.
Document the official provider, expected permissions, and safe configuration steps before users add the endpoint.
Recommend previewing target IDs, recipients, content, sender details, and schedules before write operations.

static_findings.snippet: - Active Brevo connection via `RUBE_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS` with toolkit `brevo`
- Always call `RUBE_SEARCH_TOOLS` first to get current tool schemas
**Get Rube MCP**: Add `https://rube.app/mcp` as an MCP server in your client configuration. No API k
1. Verify Rube MCP is available by confirming `RUBE_SEARCH_TOOLS` responds
- `startDate` and `endDate` are mutually required; provide both or neither
- Date filters only work when `status` is not passed or set to 'sent'
- Campaign `sender` email must be a verified sender in Brevo
- `scheduledAt` uses full ISO 8601 format with timezone
2. `BREVO_CREATE_OR_UPDATE_EMAIL_TEMPLATE` - Create a new template or update existing [Required]
- `templateId`: Include to update; omit to create new
- `htmlContent`: HTML template body (min 10 characters; use this or `htmlUrl`)
- `sender`: Sender object with `name` and `email`, or `id` (required for creation)
- When `templateId` is provided, the tool updates; when omitted, it creates
- Sender IDs can be used in `sender.id` fields for campaigns and templates
- `abTesting`: Set to `true` to enable A/B testing
- `winnerDelay`: Hours to wait before selecting winner (1-168)
- A/B testing must be enabled (`abTesting: true`) before setting variant fields
- `splitRule` is the percentage of contacts that receive variant A
- `winnerDelay` defines how long to test before sending the winner to remaining contacts
- Check `count` in response to determine total available
- Response data may be nested under `data` or `data.data`
**Get Rube MCP**: Add `https://rube.app/mcp` as an MCP server in your client configuration. No API k

content.value_statement: Brevo campaign work can require repeated tool checks and exact API parameters. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through Brevo workflows with Rube MCP.
actual_capabilities: Connects Brevo workflows through Rube MCP after user authentication.
Lists and filters email campaigns with pagination and statistics options.
Updates campaign names, subjects, senders, recipients, content, and schedules.
Creates, updates, lists, and deletes Brevo email templates.
Lists verified Brevo senders for campaigns and templates.
Guides A/B testing setup for classic Brevo campaigns.
limitations: Requires Rube MCP and an authenticated Brevo connection before use.
Does not verify sender identities inside Brevo.
Does not guarantee campaign delivery or avoid Brevo plan rate limits.
Requires current Rube tool schemas before running workflows.

use_cases.title: Audit active campaigns
use_cases.description: Review Brevo campaign status, dates, statistics, and pagination before planning updates.

use_cases.title: Maintain reusable templates
use_cases.description: Create, update, deactivate, or delete email templates with correct sender and content fields.

use_cases.title: Prepare A/B tests
use_cases.description: Configure subject variants, split rules, winner criteria, and test delay for classic campaigns.

prompt_templates.title: List recent campaigns
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Brevo skill to list recent email campaigns. Include status, type, date range, and basic statistics when available.

prompt_templates.title: Update a campaign draft
prompt_templates.prompt: Find the draft campaign named [campaign name], confirm its campaign ID, then update the subject and sender after showing the planned changes.

prompt_templates.title: Create or revise a template
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Brevo templates to create or update [template name]. Confirm required sender details, subject, active status, and personalization fields first.

prompt_templates.title: Configure an A/B test
prompt_templates.prompt: Locate the classic campaign [campaign name] and prepare A/B test settings with two subject lines, a split rule, winner criteria, and winner delay.

output_examples.input: List active campaigns from the last month.
output_examples.output: A campaign review with names, statuses, dates, IDs, and available performance statistics.

output_examples.input: Update a template with a new subject and sender.
output_examples.output: A confirmation plan showing the target template, required fields, sender identity, and update result.

output_examples.input: Prepare an A/B test for a classic campaign.
output_examples.output: A checklist covering campaign ID, variant subjects, split percentage, winner metric, delay, and constraints.

best_practices: Search Rube tools first so current Brevo schemas are used.
Confirm campaign IDs, template IDs, sender identity, and recipients before updates.
Use pagination and date filters to avoid incomplete campaign reviews.
anti_patterns: Do not update a campaign without confirming the numeric campaign ID.
Do not mix htmlContent and htmlUrl in the same update.
Do not use unverified sender emails in campaigns or templates.

faq.question: What does this skill automate?
faq.answer: It guides Brevo campaign, template, sender, and A/B testing workflows through Rube MCP.

faq.question: Does it require a Brevo API key?
faq.answer: The skill expects authentication through Rube MCP, not direct API key entry in the skill file.

faq.question: Can it send campaigns automatically?
faq.answer: It can update campaign content and scheduling fields, but final sending may require Brevo UI or available tools.

faq.question: Can it create email templates?
faq.answer: Yes. It describes how to create or update templates with names, subjects, senders, and HTML content.

faq.question: Can it manage sender verification?
faq.answer: No. It can list senders, but sender verification happens in the Brevo web interface.

faq.question: Why should tools be searched first?
faq.answer: Rube tool schemas can change, so the skill requires a fresh tool search before each workflow.
